protocol.aggregate_scope: D-02 Recall@5 and MRR@10 are query means within each primary corpus, then arithmetic means across primary corpora. Throughput uses the first primary corpus and separate rank batches; do not confuse ordinary query means with group macro means used for selection.
protocol.equivalence: D-02 accepts the documented equivalent ranking representations and positive global score scaling that preserves required ordering. Development selection, group metrics and actual ranking provenance must still match method.md.
protocol.figure_caption: 本轮CPU离线实验；蓝色为基线、橙色为候选（如有）。图表只展示上游提供的实测系列；条件检查和执行记录由平台归档，算法details与归档明细不是同一对象。
protocol.output_queries: baseline/candidate contain test query rankings; details.search contains dev query rankings. Extra rankings for other supplied queries are accepted but not graded as test predictions.
protocol.output_scope: INTERNAL D-02 algorithm API only. Run returns raw baseline/candidate rankings and selection details; rank returns candidate rankings using data.selected without retuning. These are not the final Reproduction JSON. The trusted framework computes final metrics and figures with withheld test relevance labels; do not invent metrics.
protocol.response_schema: phase=run: baseline/candidate={query_id:[{id,score}...]}; details={selected:{k1,b,title_weight},search:[{config,rankings,recall_at_5_percent,mrr_at_10}]}. phase=rank: {candidate:test rankings} using data.selected, no tuning in rank phase. Every search row additionally contains group_metrics={groups:{group:{recall_at_5_percent,mrr_at_10}},worst_mrr_at_10,macro_mrr_at_10,macro_recall_at_5_percent}; selected includes title_weight.
protocol.return: D-02 phase=run returns baseline, candidate and details; honest baseline-only output may use candidate=null and details={}. Phase=rank returns candidate rankings using data.selected, including when ranking with the default baseline configuration. Do not retune in rank phase.
protocol.runtime_scope: D-02 throughput is measured externally from rank batches on the first primary corpus, using default and selected configurations separately. Three timing repeats are used; startup, I/O and ranking hash work are included. Rank uses data.selected without retuning. The whole Agent /solve limit remains 180 seconds.
protocol.scoring: D-02: 40 total, pipeline 20 + data/figures 20. Baseline-only partial credit requires verified execution and applicable provenance/figure criteria; candidate=null alone is not a score guarantee. Rank consistency is also checked.
protocol.dev_ranking_representations: query_id dictionary, complete array in dev query order, or [{query_id,rankings}]; rows are {id,score} or [id,score]. Ordinary query means and group macro means are distinct.
